purpose: Control case: verify that a fully feasible, undisrupted plan is preserved by Workbench v1.
manual_checks: Validate reports the Scenario as valid.
Visualization shows two independent, station-continuous rotations with no disruption overlay.
Recovery matches Original for all six flights.
No aircraft or crew changes are shown.
Exported RecoveredResult contains no fake or unexplained recovery action.
design_notes: The two rotations intentionally use different equipment/rating types (E1 and E2). This removes zero-cost equivalent aircraft/crew swap optima under the canonical test cost profile.
There are no passengers and airport capacities are deliberately slack, so the baseline isolates end-to-end system correctness rather than disruption recovery.
If the exact objective is not zero, inspect cost ownership, generated resource columns, linking constraints, and result recomputation before weakening this expectation.
